# Andrew Kashella | Innovative Mortgage Services, Inc.

> Andrew Kashella (NMLS #139171) is a residential mortgage loan officer based in Dunedin, Florida, originating loans through Innovative Mortgage Services, Inc. (NMLS #250769). He serves Pinellas County, the Greater Tampa Bay area, and clients across all of Florida, with access to more than 100 lenders for purchase, refinance, and investment financing. Primary contact: call 727-564-3826 or start an application online.

## Loan Programs
- [Conventional Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/conventional-loans/): Flexible terms and competitive rates for borrowers with solid credit and stable income.
- [FHA Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/fha-loans/): Flexible qualification and low down payment options, popular with first-time buyers.
- [VA Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/va-loans/): Zero down payment and no PMI for eligible veterans, active-duty, and military families.
- [USDA Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/usda-loans/): 100% financing for qualified buyers in eligible rural and suburban Florida areas.
- [Jumbo Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/jumbo-loans/): Financing for higher-value homes above conforming loan limits.
- [Refinance](https://andrewkashella.com/refinance/): Lower your rate or payment, change your term, or switch from an ARM to fixed.
- [Cash-Out Refinance](https://andrewkashella.com/cash-out-refinance/): Access home equity for improvements, debt consolidation, or other goals.
- [Renovation Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/renovation-loans/): Finance a home purchase or refinance plus repairs and upgrades in one loan.
- [First-Time Buyer Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/first-time-buyer-loans/): Programs and guidance for first-time homebuyers in Florida.
- [Bank Statement Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/bank-statement-loans/): Qualify using bank statements instead of tax returns, built for the self-employed.
- [DSCR Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/dscr-loans/): Qualify a rental property on its own cash flow, for real estate investors.
- [Non-QM Loans](https://andrewkashella.com/non-qm-loans/): Alternative options for borrowers with complex or unique financial profiles.

## Tools
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://andrewkashella.com/calculator/): Estimate a monthly payment using the current Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate, with amortization.
